      "name": "mempool",

      "evidence": "Touches src/policy/policy.cpp and test/functional/mempool_sigoplimit.py to align policy with new consensus rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The mempool category explicitly excludes consensus validity, and the policy edits follow directly from the consensus rule changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/miner.cpp with minor adjustments following merged companion PR #35949.",
      "band": "Unranked",

    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/blockchain.cpp and test/functional/rpc_blockchain.py solely to reflect deployment status.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Exposing consensus deployment state via getblockchaininfo is behavior an RPC merely exposes and does not constitute an RPC interface change."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds unit tests, functional tests, and fuzzing harnesses specifically targeting BIP 54 validation logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning the behavior of a specific area belong to that area (validation) rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/validation.cpp, src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, and src/consensus/consensus.h.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Implements BIP 54 (Consensus Cleanup) validation rules to resolve legacy vulnerabilities including quadratic sigops, Merkle collisions (CVE-2017-12842), and timewarp attacks. As the rules are activated only on regtest via BIP 9 versionbits without mainnet activation, delay does not risk immediate consensus divergence, but the PR provides substantial strategic value by enabling testing and vetting of proposed consensus changes."
    },

      "name": "wallet",
